outcome: reasons for early introduction of complementary feeding (tea, water, other types of milk)
cohort: The study included 545 postpartum mothers (103 adolescents and 442 adults) from a maternity hospital in Brazil.
finding: Adolescent and adult mothers provided different reasons for introducing tea at 30 days and water/tea at 90 days after birth, but similar reasons for introducing another type of milk at 180 days.
